pie: polh₁úh₂ wékʷesh₂ péh₂ureh₂ dʰéh₁leh₂. dusménēs bʰéh₂ti h₁wésus wr̥ǵyéti. dʰéh₁leh₂ wiHróm déyḱeti.
english: Many words, few deeds. The ill-minded man talks; the good man works. Deeds point out the man.

pie: bʰéreti dʰéh₁leh₂ ḱléwos bʰéreti wékʷesh₂ h₂énh₁mom. h₁sudʰéh₁los wiHrós h₁suḱléwēs.
english: Deeds carry fame; words carry wind. The man of good deeds is of good fame.

pie: dʰrówgʰos bʰṓr. gʷṓs ne stéh₂yeti mórtōm ménesh₂ stéh₂yeti. nékʷti ne gʷm̥sḱéti dinóy gʷm̥sḱéti. ménos toy dinóy nékʷti-kʷe ph₂sdʰí.
english: A lie is a thief. It does not steal cattle; it steals the minds of mortals. It does not come by night; it comes by day. Guard your mind by day and by night.

pie: dʰrówgʰos témHos lubʰyéti h₁sónt bʰéh₂os lubʰyéti. bʰṓr nékʷti h₁éyti h₁sn̥tyṓys wiHrós dinóy h₁éyti. sóh₂wl̥ mórtōm dʰéh₁leh₂ dedórḱe.
english: The lie loves darkness; the truth loves light. The thief goes by night; the true man goes by day. The sun sees the deeds of mortals.

pie: owis eḱwobʰyos eweket, "ḱerd angʰetai moi widontei ǵʰm̥onm̥ eḱwons aǵontm̥."
english: The sheep said to the horses: "My heart pains me, seeing a man driving horses."

pie: kʷís ǵérh₂ont priHós? h₁yós toy h₁sónt wérh₁yeti só priHós. h₁yós te sweh₂dúbʰis wékʷesbʰis gʷr̥néHti só ne priHós. h₁éy wĺ̥kʷos.
english: Old man, who is a friend? He who tells you the truth is a friend. He who praises you with sweet words is not a friend. He is a wolf.

pie: gʰostéyey h₁sónt wérh₁ye. gʰóstim mē dʰréwgʰs. ph₂tḗr dyḗws gʰóstim h₂lékseti. h₁yós gʰóstim dʰréwgʰt só deywóns dʰréwgʰt.
english: Speak the truth to a guest. Do not deceive a stranger. Father Sky protects the guest. He who deceives a guest deceives the gods.

pie: h₁usuyéh₂bʰos dédeh₃ti h₂egʰós h₁áyto. wiHrós h₁yód dédeh₃ti tód h₁áyto. h₁wésu h₁suménesm̥ gʷm̥sḱéti.
english: The good man gives; the bad man takes. What a man gives, that he receives. Good comes to the kindly man.

pie: néḱt h₂éh₂usom méǵh₂ ḱléwos ne néḱt. bʰṓr h₂éh₂usom klépeti ḱléwos kʷis ne klépeti. h₁íd ń̥dʰrowgʰosyo misdʰós.
english: Gold is lost; great fame is not lost. A thief steals gold; no one steals fame. It is the reward of the guileless man.

pie: m̥rént gʷówes m̥rént bʰréh₂teres mért-kʷe mórtos. h₁wésu ḱléwos ne mért. ń̥dʰgʷʰitom h₂n̥rés ḱléwos gʷíh₃weti.
english: Cattle die, brothers die, and the mortal dies. Good fame does not die. The imperishable fame of a man lives.

pie: h₂ówis tu h₁eḱwoibʰ(y)os weukʷét, "ḱḗr Hegʰnutór moi h₁éḱwons Héǵontm̥ Hnérm̥ widn̥tbʰ(y)os."
english: The sheep said to the horses: "My heart pains me, seeing a man driving horses."

pie: dʰúgh₂ter polh₁éwes wiHrṓs sweh₂duwékʷeses h₁éyes-kʷe ne h₁sn̥tyṓs. wiHrósyo dʰéh₁leh₂ spéḱye h₁ésyo wékʷesh₂ mē spéḱyes. dʰéh₁leh₂ h₁sn̥tyéh₂.
english: Daughter, many men are sweet of speech, and they are not true. Look at a man's deeds; do not look at his words. Deeds are true.

pie: h₁yód gʰrémesi th₂kéh₁ye. h₁yód toy ménos h₃reǵtóm nu bʰh₂dʰí. gʰrémontos wiHróh₁ wékʷos ǵʰoysós. priHóm térh₃t.
english: When you rage, be silent. When your mind is straight, then speak. The word of a raging man is a spear. It wounds a friend.

pie: ḱḗr polh₁úh₂ wéḱti ménesh₂ péh₂ureh₂ wélh₁t. h₁yósyo ménos h₃reǵtóm só h₃reǵtóy stóygʰoy stéygʰeti. h₁ésyo pódh₁e ne h₃slidʰtā́m.
english: The heart wants many things; the mind chooses few. He whose mind is straight walks on a straight path. His feet do not slip.

pie: dʰúgh₂ter dn̥ǵʰwéh₂m ǵʰóstoh₁ ḱḗr-kʷe ph₂sdʰí. térh₃t dn̥ǵʰwéh₂s stéh₂yeti ǵʰóstos ḱḗr-kʷe h₂egʰéh₂ wéḱti. h₁yéh₂ ḱéh₂ péh₂sti séh₂ h₁uséwih₂ gʷḗn.
english: Daughter, guard the tongue, the hands and the heart. The tongue wounds, the hand steals, and the heart wants evil things. She who guards these is a good woman.

pie: h₂yuHn̥ḱósyo h₂r̥Hmóh₁ ḱuh₁róh₁ ǵr̥h₂n̥tés ménos ǵn̥h₃róm. h₂yuHn̥ḱós bʰéh₂ti ǵérh₂onts th₂kéh₁yeti wóyde-kʷe. h₂yuHn̥ḱósyo ǵʰóstos ǵn̥h₃rósyo-kʷe ménos dṓm démetes.
english: The arms of the young man are strong; the mind of the old man is wise. The young man speaks; the old man is silent and knows. The hand of the young man and the mind of the wise man build a house.

pie: súHnew toy ph₂térm̥ ḱléwse. polh₁úh₂ ḱlush₁yé péh₂ureh₂-kʷe mluHdʰí. mórtoybʰos h₁sónt wr̥h₁dʰí. priHóm toy mē dʰréwgʰs. dʰrówgʰos h₁ógʷʰis. tóm gʷr̥h₃éti h₁yós h₁ím bʰéreti.
english: Son, listen to your father. Hear many things, and say few. Speak the truth to mortals. Do not deceive your friend. A lie is a snake. It devours him who carries it.

pie: h₁éwseti péh₂wr̥ ǵʰóstom h₂egʰóm wékʷos ḱḗr h₁éwseti. dʰuh₂mós péh₂wr̥ sékʷetor ḱéh₂dos-kʷe dʰrówgʰom sékʷetor. ǵʰóstos kéh₂ilos h₂ew bʰuHyéti ḱḗr kéh₂ilom ne bʰuHyéti.
english: Fire burns the hand; a bad word burns the heart. Smoke follows fire, and grief follows a lie. The hand becomes whole again; the heart does not become whole.

pie: téḱnom sddʰí ḱléwse-kʷe. pl̥h₁úbʰis ǵʰéyomn̥s dedórḱh₂e. tinéh₁ti snóygʷʰos sh₂wéni tinéh₁ti dʰrówgʰos bʰéh₂esi. h₁sónt h₂éḱmō ne tinéh₁ti.
english: Child, sit down and listen. I have seen many winters. Snow melts in the sun; a lie melts in the light. The truth is a stone; it does not melt.

pie: dedórḱe h₃ókʷ ḱlush₁yéti h₂ṓws wóyde-kʷe ǵnéh₃meh₂. h₃ókʷ h₁yód dedórḱe tód h₁sn̥tyóm. h₂ṓws h₁yód ḱlush₁yéti tód h₂énh₁mos.
english: The eye sees, the ear hears, and the judgement knows. What the eye has seen, that is true. What the ear hears, that is wind.

pie: péh₂urom péh₂wr̥ méǵh₂m̥ dṓm h₁éwseti. péh₂uros dʰrówgʰos méǵh₂ h₁nómn̥ h₁éwseti. péh₂wr̥ toy h₁éh₃si mē bʰéres.
english: A small fire burns a great house. A small lie burns a great name. Do not carry fire in your mouth.

pie: mógʰew toy ménos yugdʰí. wiHrósyo ménos HeHḱús h₁éḱwos. ń̥yugom ménos stóygʰōd h₃sléydʰt. h₁yós swóm ménos yéwgt só swóm dṓm h₁r̥sḱéti.
english: Young man, yoke your mind. The mind of a man is a swift horse. An unyoked mind slips from the path. He who yokes his mind arrives at his own home.

pie: h₃ésth₁ dn̥ǵʰwéh₂i ne h₁ésti h₁íh₂-kʷe h₃ésth₁h₂ Hrunépti. mógʰew h₁íh₂m̥ ph₂sdʰí. h₁yód h₁éǵʰs h₁éyti tód kʷis wékʷos ne kapyéti.
english: In the tongue there is no bone, and it breaks bones. Guard it, young man. The word that goes out, no one seizes.

pie: h₁sónt m̥dʰéwi h₁ésti. h₁yós médʰu píph₃eti só kʷid ne kéwdʰeti. népot píph₃e ménos-kʷe toy ph₂sdʰí.
english: Truth is in mead. He who drinks mead hides nothing. Grandson, drink, and guard your mind.

pie: súHnew h₁eǵóh₂ ǵérh₂onts. wékʷesh₂ moy ḱludʰí. gʰóstim mē gʰroméyes bʰoydʰéh₂m mē Hrunéps. deywóns sepelyé méh₂term̥-kʷe toy stérge. h₁wésu te ḱléwos sékʷoyh₁to.
english: Son, I am old. Hear my words. Do not anger a guest; do not break an oath. Honor the gods, and cherish your mother. May good fame follow you.

pie: kʷíd méh₂ter wiHrṓs dʰrugʰyónti? súHnew h₁yós dʰrugʰyéti só bʰebʰóyh₂e h₁yós-kʷe bʰebʰóyh₂e só dʰrugʰyéti. h₁yós ne bʰebʰóyh₂e só h₁sónt sokʷéyeti.
english: Mother, why do men deceive? Son, he who deceives is afraid, and he who is afraid deceives. He who is not afraid speaks the truth.

pie: deywós wérunos diwés km̥tá gʷah₂t.
english: The god Werunos came down from heaven.

pie: ḱḗr h₁yód wéḱti ǵʰóstos tód dédeh₃ti. dusménesos dóh₃r̥ wisós. péh₂urom ḱéywosyo priHósyo dóh₃r̥ méǵh₂.
english: What the heart wishes, the hand gives. The gift of an ill-minded man is poison. The small gift of a dear friend is great.
